project.name: Project 2 - IceStream
project.objective: Develop all six modules independently and in parallel without waiting for another member's code. Use sample or mock data where integration is not yet available.

responsibilities: Create a Python script to generate e-commerce transaction data
Send transaction data to a Kafka topic
Include bad data such as NULL values, missing fields, wrong data types, invalid values, and duplicates
Set up the Flink processing module
Use sample JSON data initially
Read and process transaction events
Produce processed output
Do not wait for Kafka integration
Set up the Apache Iceberg environment
Create the main transaction table
Create the DLQ table
Use sample data initially
Test writing and retrieving data independently
Create Python data-quality validation rules
Check NULL values
Check missing columns
Check incorrect data types
Check duplicate transaction IDs
Return clear PASS or FAIL results with reasons
Create circuit-breaker logic independently
Calculate error percentage
Set status to QUARANTINED when error rate is greater than 2%
Implement HEALTHY, WARNING, QUARANTINED, and RECOVERING states
Use sample quality results initially
Create the React Flow pipeline UI
Show Kafka -> Flink -> Iceberg -> Data Quality -> Analytics
Add node statuses such as HEALTHY, FAILED, and PAUSED
Use mock or static status data initially
Do not wait for backend integration

week_1_workflow.day_1: Start assigned module and complete initial project setup.
week_1_workflow.day_3: Complete the main functionality of the assigned module.
week_1_workflow.day_4: Test the module independently using sample or mock data.
week_1_workflow.day_5: Fix issues, improve functionality, and prepare the demonstration.
week_1_workflow.day_6: Finalize the module and prepare it for integration.
week_1_workflow.day_7: Complete documentation, demonstrate the module, and confirm GitHub work is pushed.

github_rules.branch_rule: Each member must work only on their assigned branch.
github_rules.commit_frequency: Commit and push work regularly, preferably every day.
examples: week-1-4: test module with sample transaction data
week-1-5: fix validation and error handling
week-1-7: complete Week 1 module and documentation
github_rules.multiple_commits_same_day: Multiple commits on the same day may use the same day number.
rules: Do not wait for another member's code.
Use sample JSON or mock data when dependencies are not ready.
Do not modify another member's assigned module without discussion.
Push completed work to the assigned GitHub branch.
Keep commits small, clear, and related to the day's work.

success_criteria: Each member has tested their assigned module
Each member has committed and pushed their Week 1 work
Each member can demonstrate their module
The team is ready to begin integration
